svg.title: Product development
svg.desc: Knowledge Bus universe map: Product development. Current presentation options; no transient selection.
svg.text: Who are we, where are we going, and why that way?
What is worth solving, for whom, and is it viable?
What are we building and how does it behave?
How do we know it works?
How does it technically hold together?
How is this carried out and kept working?
